site.name: ailearning
promise: How machines learn, drawn as machines you can tune.
From one neuron to transformers. Turn the dials.
Modern AI, one working drawing at a time.
site.subline: Neuron → learning → transformers → graph networks → the frontier.
site.sound: Sound on: every plate is narrated.

strip.label: Watch
strip.line: A narrated plate explains one idea, start to finish.

strip.label: Drive
strip.line: You turn the dials while the plate guides your hand.

strip.label: Play
strip.line: Games on the same machine, at your own pace.

credits.colophon: Drawn, written and narrated by Claude.

units.title: The neuron
units.line: A neuron adds its inputs, each turned by a dial, and passes one number on.

units.title: Layers and creases
units.line: Each neuron adds one crease; without the valve, any stack is one straight line.

units.title: Loss
units.line: One number for how wrong the machine is: the mean of the squared misses.

units.title: The gradient
units.line: Nudge each dial, read its slope, and the slopes combine into one arrow pointing uphill.

units.title: Gradient descent
units.line: Step against the arrow, again and again. The tuner from Plate I was doing this.

units.title: The chain rule
units.line: Linked stages multiply: turn the first gear and the last turns by the product.

units.title: Backpropagation
units.line: One backward sweep hands every dial its slope, from the loss to the first layer.

units.title: Generalisation
units.line: A curve through every training point can still miss every point it never saw.

units.title: Vectors
units.line: A list of numbers is one arrow, and the neuron's inputs were one all along.

units.title: Dot product
units.line: One arrow's shadow on another gives the same number the neuron's needle read.

units.title: Tokens
units.line: Text is cut into pieces, and each piece is stamped with a number.

units.title: Embeddings
units.line: Each token number opens a vector, and directions in that space carry meaning.

units.title: Softmax
units.line: Any row of scores becomes shares that are positive and add up to one.

units.title: Next-token prediction
units.line: A language model scores every possible next piece, picks one, and repeats.

units.title: The transformer map
units.line: One duct per token; every floor reads from it and writes back into it.

units.title: Attention, the idea
units.line: The same word moves to a different place depending on the words around it.

units.title: Query, key and value
units.line: Each word asks with a query, answers with a key and hands over a value.

units.title: The attention pattern and the mask
units.line: The future is covered; double the context and the table grows fourfold.

units.title: Multi-head attention
units.line: Twelve heads read the same text, each for its own kind of pattern.

units.title: The MLP block
units.line: Each token passes a wide bank of valves that writes facts back into its duct.

units.title: Position
units.line: Without position, 'dog bites man' and 'man bites dog' look the same to attention.

units.title: Residuals and normalisation
units.line: A bypass duct lets the learning signal cross dozens of layers without fading.

units.title: The whole machine and pretraining
units.line: One token followed through every floor, from text in to the next word out.

units.title: Graphs as data
units.line: Atoms and bonds, or words in a line: both are nodes joined by edges.

units.title: Message passing
units.line: Each round, every node gathers from its neighbours, and news spreads one edge further.

units.title: What a GNN cannot tell apart
units.line: Some different graphs look identical to a message-passing network, round after round.

units.title: Over-squashing
units.line: Too many messages forced through one narrow bridge arrive as a faint trace.

units.title: The transformer is a GNN
units.line: An attention table is a graph with an edge between every pair of words.

units.title: Symmetry and equivariance
units.line: Rotate the molecule and the predicted forces turn with it, by construction.

units.title: Mixture of experts
units.line: A router sends each token to two of many experts, so most of the machine rests.

units.title: Recurrence and state
units.line: A fixed-size memory updated once per token, however long the text runs.

units.title: Selectivity (Mamba)
units.line: Each token sets how much to write into the memory and how much to keep.

units.title: Linear attention and the delta rule
units.line: The table folds into one square memory, and the delta rule erases before it writes.

units.title: Diffusion
units.line: Learn to remove noise, then start from pure noise and remove it step by step.

units.title: Flow matching
units.line: A field of arrows carries every point of plain noise straight to the data.

units.title: Diffusion for text
units.line: Every word starts blank, and the surest ones are set first, anywhere in the line.

units.title: Reinforcement learning
units.line: Actions that earned more reward become more likely, loopholes included.

units.title: Learning from human preference
units.line: Many ticks between two answers become a reward model, with a tether to the start.

units.title: Rewards you can check
units.line: Many answers to one problem, each checked, pulled toward the ones that passed.

units.title: Test-time compute
units.line: A small model that thinks longer can beat a large one that answers at once.

units.title: Recursive latent reasoning
units.line: One small machine, run in a loop, refines its own answer pass after pass.

units.title: World models
units.line: The agent plans on its own drawn copy of the world, then runs the plan for real.

units.title: Superposition and sparse features
units.line: A layer stores more features than it has dimensions, and they can be pulled apart.
